architecture: Opposed actuator outputs; crank between hip and knee actuators. Two structural longitudinal thigh halves contain a keyed hip flange pocket and integral knee stator bulkhead.
removed_mounting_layers: Six tube segments around those ties
retained_custom_hardware: Existing knee bearings, axle sleeve and spacer
nominal_width_basis: Actual world-space part bounds in the standing pose; geometry only.
manufacturing_limitations: Longitudinal halves expose pockets, motor mounts and wiring. Print orientation and CNC setups require review.
No strength or screw engagement qualification.
Knee actuator direction reverses; encoder/control sign needs calibration.
Narrower foot spacing changes lateral stability; gait and load capability are not established.
